18647.zhDesc: 放逐敌对目标，使其完全无法行动，但也不会受到任何伤害，最多持续30秒。每个术士在同一时间内只能放逐一个目标，只能对恶魔和元素生物使用。
18647.enDesc: Banishes the enemy target, preventing all action but making it invulnerable for up to 30 sec. Only one target can be banished at a time. Only works on Demons and Elementals.

18670.zhDesc: 对敌人造成普通武器伤害再加上30点额外伤害，并将其击退。
18670.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 30 to an enemy and knocks it back.

18702.zhDesc: 使敌人的力量降低50点，耐力降低50点，持续1分钟。
18702.enDesc: Reduces an enemy's Strength by 50 and Stamina by 50 for 1 min.

18945.zhDesc: 对敌人造成普通武器伤害再加上30点额外伤害，并将其击退。
18945.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 30 to an enemy and knocks it back.

19134.zhDesc: 向目标发出怒吼，使其因恐惧而被麻痹，并使附近的其它敌人逃跑，持续8秒。
19134.enDesc: Shouts at an enemy, paralyzing it with terror for 8 sec. and causing all other nearby enemies to flee in fear.

19319.zhDesc: 撕咬敌人，对其造成物理伤害。
19319.enDesc: Bites an enemy, inflicting Physical damage.

19983.zhDesc: 对目标和它身边最近的敌人造成你的武器伤害再加50点伤害，最多可影响10个目标。
19983.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 50 to an enemy and its nearest allies, affecting up to 10 targets.

20252.zhDesc: 向敌人冲锋，造成25点伤害，并使其昏迷3秒。
20252.enDesc: Charge an enemy, causing 25 damage and stunning it for 3 sec.

20537.zhDesc: 反制敌人的法术，使其在15秒内无法施放该法术。产生很高的威胁值。
20537.enDesc: Counters an enemy's spell, preventing the enemy from casting that spell again for 15 sec. Generates a high amount of threat.

20539.zhDesc: 从敌人身上吸取200点生命值，并使施法者恢复最多相当于该数值两倍的生命值。
20539.enDesc: Drains 200 health from an enemy, healing the caster for up to twice that amount.

20569.zhDesc: 发动横扫攻击，对目标及附近的另一名敌人造成武器伤害外加50点伤害。
20569.enDesc: A sweeping attack that does your weapon damage plus 50 to the target and his nearest ally.

20787.zhDesc: 灼烧敌人，并对其每3秒造成一次额外火焰伤害，持续21秒。
20787.enDesc: Burns an enemy, then inflicts additional Fire damage every 3 sec. for 21 sec.

20800.zhDesc: 灼烧敌人，并对其每3秒造成一次额外火焰伤害，持续21秒。

20812.zhDesc: 使敌人的攻击间隔延长100%，移动速度降低50%，力量降低50%。持续15秒。
20812.enDesc: Increased the time between an enemy's attacks by 100% and its movement by 50%, in addition to reducing its Strength by 50%. Lasts 15 sec.

20904.zhDesc: 瞄准射击，使远程伤害提高166点。瞄准射击与多重射击共享冷却时间。
20904.enDesc: An aimed shot that increases ranged damage by 600.

21007.zhDesc: 使附近敌人的物理伤害能力降低1点，持续2分钟。每个术士只能对一个目标施加一种诅咒，且同类诅咒不能叠加。
21007.enDesc: Reduces the Physical damage dealt by nearby enemies by 1 for 2 min. Only one curse per warlock can be active on any one target.

21049.zhDesc: 使一个友方玩家的攻击速度提高30%，持续30秒。
21049.enDesc: Increases an ally's attack speed by 30% for 30 sec.

21060.zhDesc: 使目标暂时失明并到处乱走，持续最多10秒。任何对其造成的伤害都会解除此效果。
21060.enDesc: Blinds the target, causing it to wander confused for up to 10 sec. Any damage caused will remove the effect.

21687.enDesc: Inflicts Nature damage to an enemy.

21793.zhDesc: 对指定区域内的敌人造成自然伤害，使它们的移动速度降低70%，攻击间隔延长300%，持续10秒。
21793.enDesc: Deals nature damage to enemies in an area over 10 sec, slowing their movement by 70% and increasing the time between their attacks by 300%.

21869.zhDesc: 向敌人发出咆哮，使其因恐惧而麻痹8秒，并令附近的其它敌人因恐惧而逃跑。
21869.enDesc: Roars at an enemy, paralyzing it with terror for 8 sec. and causing all other nearby enemies to flee in fear.

22128.zhDesc: 使友方目标身上环绕着荆棘，对任何使用近战手段击中被保护者的敌人造成20点自然伤害，持续10分钟。
22128.enDesc: Thorns sprout from the friendly target causing 20 Nature damage to attackers when hit. Lasts 10 min.

22187.zhDesc: 立即为目标加上魔法护盾，可吸收206点物理或魔法伤害，最多持续30秒。只要护盾存在，受保护者的施法就不会被物理攻击打断。
22187.enDesc: Wraps an ally in a shield that lasts up to 30 sec., absorbing a maximum of 206 Physical or magical damage. While the shield holds, spells will not be interrupted by Physical attacks.

22371.zhDesc: 使目标所能造成的魔法伤害降低1点，持续2分钟。
22371.enDesc: Decreases the Magical damage dealt by the target by 1 for 2 min.

22420.zhDesc: 使附近敌人的耐力降低10点，持续1分钟。
22420.enDesc: Reduces the Stamina of nearby enemies by 10 for 1 min.

22478.zhDesc: 每3秒对附近的敌人造成200点暗影伤害，持续15秒。
22478.enDesc: Inflicts 200 Shadow damage to nearby enemies every 3 sec. for 15 sec.

22540.zhDesc: 对目标和它身边最近的一个敌人造成你的武器伤害再加20点伤害。
22540.enDesc: Inflicts weapon damage plus 20 to an enemy and its nearest ally.

22566.zhDesc: 将附近的敌人变成青蛙，使它们无法攻击或施法，持续8秒。
22566.enDesc: Transforms nearby enemies into frogs, rendering them unable to attack or cast spells for 8 sec.

22665.zhDesc: 向附近的敌人射出多支暗影箭，对它们造成暗影伤害。
22665.enDesc: Hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

22689.zhDesc: 每2秒对敌人造成200点伤害，并使其移动速度降低50%，持续20秒。
22689.enDesc: Inflicts 200 damage to an enemy every 2 sec. and slows its movement by 50% for 20 sec.

22691.zhDesc: 使敌人无法使用武器作战，持续6秒。
22691.enDesc: Disarms an enemy, forcing it to stop wielding its weapon for 6 sec.

22709.zhDesc: 向目标射出一支暗影箭，对其造成925至1075点暗影伤害。
22709.enDesc: Sends a bolt of dark magic at an enemy, inflicting 925 to 1075 Shadow damage.

22715.zhDesc: 击退附近的敌人，并使它们的移动速度降低到普通速度的38至62%。
22715.enDesc: Knocks nearby enemies back and reduces their movement speed to 38 to 62% of normal for until cancelled.

22857.zhDesc: 立刻反击一个对你进行了近战攻击的敌人，效果持续15秒。从你背后发动的攻击无法被反击。
22857.enDesc: Instantly counterattack any enemy that strikes you in melee for 15 sec. Melee attacks made from behind cannot be counterattacked.

22859.zhDesc: 对目标造成150%的武器伤害并使其受伤，任何对其使用的治疗技能效果减弱50%，持续5秒。
22859.enDesc: Inflicts 150% weapon damage and leaves the target wounded, reducing the effectiveness of any healing by 50% for 5 sec.

22884.zhDesc: 发出心灵尖啸，使附近最多5个敌人逃跑，持续4秒。
22884.enDesc: Lets out a psychic scream, causing up to 5 nearby enemies to flee for 4 sec.

22886.zhDesc: 对敌人发起冲锋，将其击退并造成普通伤害外加300点伤害。
22886.enDesc: Charges at an enemy, knocking it back and inflicting normal damage plus 300.

22908.zhDesc: 持续向目标区域射击，每秒对半径8码范围内的敌人造成300点奥术伤害，持续6秒。
22908.enDesc: Continuously fires a volley of ammo at the target area, causing 300 Arcane damage to enemy targets within 8 yards every second for 6 sec.

22910.zhDesc: 放置一个火焰陷阱，在敌人接近时会将其灼烧，在15秒内对其造成690点火焰伤害。陷阱可以存在1分钟。只能在非战斗状态下布置陷阱。每次只能布置一个陷阱。
22910.enDesc: Place a fire trap that will burn the first enemy to approach for 690 Fire damage over 15 sec. Trap will exist for 1 min. Traps can only be placed when out of combat. Only one trap can be active at a time.

22914.zhDesc: 钉刺目标，使其移动速度降低50%，持续3秒。
22914.enDesc: Dazes an enemy, reducing its movement speed by 50% for 3 sec.

22916.zhDesc: 对目标造成普通伤害外加50点伤害，将它击退。
22916.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 50 to an enemy, knocking it back.

22917.zhDesc: 进入暗影形态，使你能造成的暗影伤害提高40%，受到近战攻击时承受的伤害降低40%。暗影形态一直持续，直到主动取消。
22917.enDesc: Assumes a Shadowform, increasing Shadow damage dealt by 40% and reducing melee damage taken by 40%. Shadowform lasts until cancelled.

22919.zhDesc: 对目标造成暗影伤害，并使其移动速度降低，持续3秒。
22919.enDesc: Inflicts Shadow damage to an enemy and reduces its movement speed for 3 sec.

22920.zhDesc: 以奥术魔法冲击敌人，将其击退并造成普通伤害外加875至1125点伤害。
22920.enDesc: Blasts an enemy with Arcane magic, inflicting normal damage plus 875 to 1125 and knocking the enemy back.

22924.zhDesc: 对附近的敌人造成物理伤害，将它们击倒并使其无法移动，持续10秒。
22924.enDesc: Inflicts Physical damage to nearby enemies, knocking them down and immobilizing them for 10 sec.

22994.zhDesc: 使一个敌人被定身，每3秒对其造成一次自然伤害，最多持续10秒。
22994.enDesc: Entangles an enemy in roots, inflicting Nature damage every 3 sec. and immobilizing it for up to 10 sec.

23511.zhDesc: 使附近敌人的近战攻击强度降低40点，持续15秒。
23511.enDesc: Reduces the melee attack power of nearby enemies by 40 for 15 sec.

24375.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 500 to nearby enemies, knocking them back and stunning them for 5 sec.

25054.enDesc: Smites an enemy, inflicting Holy damage.

25055.zhDesc: 向目标射出一支魔法箭，对其造成奥术伤害。
25055.enDesc: Hurls a magical bolt at an enemy, inflicting Arcane damage.

25174.zhDesc: 对目标和其附近的盟友造成普通武器伤害再加上30点额外伤害，最多可影响3个目标。同时使其护甲降低240点。
25174.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 30 to an enemy and its nearest allies, affecting up to 3 targets. Hits also reduce armor by 240.

25309.zhDesc: 灼烧敌人，对其造成[279 * (((1)))]点火焰伤害，并在15秒内造成额外的510点火焰伤害。
25309.enDesc: Burns the enemy for [279 * (((1)))] Fire damage and then an additional 510 Fire damage over 15 sec.

25311.zhDesc: 腐蚀目标，在18秒内造成累计438点伤害。
25311.enDesc: Corrupts the target, causing 822 Shadow damage over 18 sec.

25315.zhDesc: 治疗目标，在15秒内恢复总计970点生命值。
25315.enDesc: Heals the target of 970 damage over 15 sec.

25322.zhDesc: 对施法者面前一个锥形区域中的敌人造成普通武器伤害再加上1750至2250点额外伤害，并将它们击退。
25322.enDesc: Inflicts normal damage plus 1750 to 2250 to enemies in a cone in front of the caster, knocking them back.

25346.zhDesc: 向目标射出一枚奥术飞弹，对其造成230点伤害。
25346.enDesc: Launches an Arcane Missile at the enemy, causing 230 Arcane damage.

25852.zhDesc: 使目标昏迷2秒，并有一定几率缴械。
25852.enDesc: Stuns an enemy for 2 sec. and has a chance to disarm.

26048.zhDesc: 对敌人造成暗影伤害，同时产生很高的威胁值。
26048.enDesc: Inflicts Shadow damage to an enemy, but causes a high amount of threat.

26070.zhDesc: 使敌人因为极度的恐惧而奔逃，最多持续8秒。在同一时间内，只有1个敌人会被你的恐惧术影响。
26070.enDesc: Strikes fear in an enemy, causing it to flee in terror for up to 8 sec. Only 1 target can be feared at a time.

26192.zhDesc: 制造一次以施法者为中心的魔法爆炸，对附近的敌人造成奥术伤害。
26192.enDesc: Sends out a blast wave of magic, inflicting Arcane damage to nearby enemies.

28340.zhDesc: 使施法者自动对周围的敌人每2秒造成150点暗影伤害。该光环的效果一直持续到主动取消。
28340.enDesc: Causes the caster to automatically inflict 150 Shadow damage every 2 sec. to nearby enemies. The aura lasts until cancelled.

28599.zhDesc: 向附近的敌人射出多支暗影箭，对它们造成暗影伤害。
28599.enDesc: Hurls missiles of dark magic, inflicting Shadow damage to nearby enemies.

30225.zhDesc: 使附近的敌人因沉默而不能施法，持续8秒。
30225.enDesc: Silences nearby enemies, preventing them from casting spells for 8 sec.
